metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.3 · 2007 · Paranormal Activity
metas.description: After moving into a suburban home, a couple becomes increasingly disturbed by a nightly demonic presence.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 5.3 · 2021 · Paranormal Activity: Next of Kin
